title: Stokes on an annulus and a disk
promptMarkdown: On the oriented planar annulus $A=\{1\le x^2+y^2\le4\}$ let $\omega=(-y\,dx+x\,dy)/(x^2+y^2)$ and $\eta=x\,dy-y\,dx$. Compute $d\omega,d\eta$, and both boundary integrals with the induced orientations. Explain why applying Stokes to $\omega$ on the whole disk of radius 2 is invalid, whereas it is valid for $\eta$.
hintLadder: The inner boundary orientation is reversed.
Check where each form is defined before choosing an integration domain.
